skill.name: x-publish
skill.description: Create X tweet and thread drafts with Playwright browser automation, using clipboard helpers and draft-only safeguards.
skill.summary: Prepare X tweets and threads, paste them into compose, and save them as drafts for manual review.
skill.author: kangarooking

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown fences, inline examples, fixed X URLs, or fixed clipboard subprocess calls without shell interpolation. The confirmed issue is the documented use of predictable /tmp/tweet.txt files for draft content, which can expose unpublished text on shared systems. No prompt injection or hidden exfiltration intent was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: Predictable temporary file for draft content
remediation.suggestion: Use stdin, a securely created user-owned temporary file, or a workspace-local file with restricted permissions. Delete draft files after copying.

remediation.issue: Clipboard helper depends on PATH-resolved Linux tools
remediation.suggestion: Document trusted xclip or xsel installation requirements, and prefer resolved absolute paths when running in managed environments.
Keep the draft-only rule and require explicit user confirmation before any future workflow can publish a post.

content.value_statement: Posting draft tweets through browser steps can be repetitive and error prone. This skill prepares tweets, opens X compose, pastes content, and saves drafts for manual review.
actual_capabilities: Copies short tweet text to the system clipboard for pasting into X compose.
Opens the X compose page through browser automation.
Supports multi-post thread workflows with separate tweet segments.
Pastes prepared content into compose fields and adds thread posts.
Closes compose and saves the result as an X draft.
Reports the draft location and common login or network errors.
limitations: Requires Playwright browser automation and an active X login session.
Does not publish posts automatically by design.
Depends on local clipboard support and platform-specific Python packages.
Cannot guarantee X interface labels remain stable across product updates.

use_cases.title: Draft a short announcement
use_cases.description: Prepare one tweet, paste it into X compose, and save it for a final human review.

use_cases.title: Stage a technical thread
use_cases.description: Turn segmented thread text into separate X compose entries without publishing immediately.

use_cases.title: Prepare localized social updates
use_cases.description: Save bilingual or localized draft posts so a reviewer can check tone before publication.

prompt_templates.title: Save One Tweet
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a single draft.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use x-publish to save this as an X draft: [tweet text]. Do not publish it.

prompt_templates.title: Save a Thread
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request with prepared thread segments.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use x-publish to create an X thread draft from these numbered posts. Save it as a draft only: [thread text].

prompt_templates.title: Check Length Before Drafting
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request that needs length handling.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this post for the X character limit, split it into a thread if needed, then save it as a draft: [content].

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Review-Ready Campaign Drafts
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for controlled publishing workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create review-ready X drafts for these campaign messages. Keep each post clear, save drafts only, and report how many drafts were prepared: [messages].

output_examples.input: Save this launch announcement as an X draft.
output_examples.output: Draft saved. Review it in the X drafts area before publishing.

output_examples.input: Create a three-post thread draft from this outline.
output_examples.output: Thread draft saved with three posts. Please review order, links, and wording in X drafts.

output_examples.input: This post is too long. Prepare it for X.
output_examples.output: The content was split into a thread draft. Review each post for context and final wording.

best_practices: Review every saved draft manually before publishing from X.
Use secure temporary storage or stdin for sensitive draft text.
Keep thread segments numbered so order is easy to verify.
anti_patterns: Do not ask the skill to publish automatically.
Do not store confidential draft text in shared temporary paths.
Do not run the workflow when the active X account is not confirmed.

faq.question: Does this skill publish tweets automatically?
faq.answer: No. It is designed to save posts as drafts for manual review and publishing.

faq.question: What tools are required?
faq.answer: It requires Playwright browser automation, Python, clipboard dependencies, and an active X login session.

faq.question: Can it create threads?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports prepared thread content split into separate posts.

faq.question: Does it work without logging in to X?
faq.answer: No. The browser session must already be logged in before drafts can be created.

faq.question: Can it handle posts over 280 characters?
faq.answer: It can split long content into a thread or warn before saving the draft.

faq.question: Is draft text sent to another service?
faq.answer: No evidence found. The reviewed workflow copies text locally and opens X compose pages.
